integrity: The stability function is reconstructed from the two-stage Radau IIA method, the nilpotent-shift expansion is proved analytically, and exact rational checks replay every displayed coefficient, root bracket, and sign witness. Finite checks support but do not replace the interval proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to homogeneous unit-rate absorbing pure-birth chains through the first failing state count. It does not classify arbitrary CTMC generators, nonuniform birth rates, internal stages, or higher-stage Radau IIA schemes. A highly relevant broad positivity paper by Horvath was available only at abstract/metadata level, so equivalent older coverage under a general theorem remains a residual originality risk.
title: A six-state re-entrant positivity threshold for two-stage Radau IIA on pure-birth chains
